name: Expecto Patronum
primary:
From Harry Potter. A silvery stag gallops out of your wand and runs 40 blocks forward along the ground for 3 s. Foes it tramples, at most once every 0.5 s:
• Damage 2 ❤ arcane, 4 ❤ to the undead
• Thrown aside
Allies it passes lose withering and blindness.
self_description: The stag circles around you at 3 blocks for 3 s and guards you the same way.
